# Set A: the 86 open dataset pull requests of nemarDatasets, frozen for the calibration of the
# review's change summary (epic nemarOrg/nemar-cli#1851, issue #1858). Listed on 2026-10-20 with
# `gh search prs --owner nemarDatasets --state open` (89 results; the 3 in nemarDatasets/.github are
# not dataset pull requests). One line per pull request: `<dataset>#<number> <base> <head>`, the
# base commit GitHub recorded on the pull request and its head, as fetched that day. Dataset ids,
# numbers and commit ids are public; nothing else of a pull request is kept here.
#
# Read it with the commits pinned, offline, from clones made before:
#   bun run scripts/ci/pr-review-calibrate.ts --evidence-only --offline --clones DIR \
#     --prs test/fixtures/pr-review-canary/set-a.txt --json
# or, online and with no clones, `--evidence-only` alone fetches each pull request by its ids.
#
# To re-create the clone of one line, as the review job makes one (no checkout, no gh):
#   git init -q DIR/<dataset>-<number>
#   git -C DIR/<dataset>-<number> remote add origin https://github.com/nemarDatasets/<dataset>.git
#   git -C DIR/<dataset>-<number> config extensions.partialClone origin
#   git -C DIR/<dataset>-<number> fetch --no-tags --filter=blob:none origin <base> <head>
#   git -C DIR/<dataset>-<number> update-ref refs/remotes/pr/head <head>
#   printf '%s %s\n' <base> <head> > DIR/<dataset>-<number>.shas
# then run once without --offline, so git fetches the blobs the review reads; --offline then reads
# the same clones with no network. A head force-pushed away since is no longer on GitHub: its line
# reads fetch_failed, and the totals are recomputed without it.
